correctness.rationale: For SPD quadratic and exact line search, source SRMIL/SMRMIL coefficient reduces to β_{k+1}=g_{k+1}·(g_{k+1}−g_k)/||d_k||² and spectral factor becomes one. Exact orthogonality yields β1=||g1||²/||g0||² and d0ᵀAd1=0. Under g1,g2 !=0, the first conjugacy and search conditions force g2⊥g1, giving β2=||g2||²/||d1||², α1 d1ᵀAd1=||g1||², g2ᵀAd1=||g2||²/α1; substituting gives d2ᵀAd1=(d1ᵀAd1)||g2||²(1/||d1||²−1/||g1||²)<0 because ||d1||²=||g1||²+β1²||d0||²>||g1||². In dimensions 1,2 first 1,2 conjugate directions suffice. Independent SymPy exact SPD A=diag(1,2,3), x0=(1,1,1) gave alphas 7/18,342/581,9764867/13418142, defect −38/4067 and nonzero g3=(32871,52536,−45981)/9769349. The witness proves failure of dimension-step termination, not universal divergence.
